newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telemig Q1 net rises to 73.47 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Telemig Q1 net rises to 73.47 mln reais.

text.p: Telemig, a unit of Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras serving Minas Gerais state, issued the following preliminary first-quarter results.
NOTE: All figures are in Brazilian reais and not adjusted for inflation.
The figure for share profit is per lot of 1,000 shares.
Telemig also reported a gross profit in the three-month period of 186.97 million reais compared with 133.39 million reais in the same period last year.

The company also reported an operating profit of 111.26 million reais in the quarter versus 75.29 million reais in the period and pre-tax profit of 110.51 million reais compared with 76.34 million reais in the same period last year.
Net worth per lot of 1,000 shares totalled 78.22 reais versus 67.31 reais in 1996's first quarter.
